name: Suwałki County (Poland)
description: A banner-style flag in the ratio 1:2 with a red field surrounded by a white border and a cut-away lower fly corner, charged towards the hoist with the county arms of Suwałki: a shield with a fir tree between wavy stripes on blue.
history: Polish county (powiat) and city flags are established by resolution of the council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
